theory Sine_Key
  imports Complex_Main
begin

text \<open>Elementary sine/cosine inequalities, proved from the monotonicity of \<open>x - sin x\<close>.\<close>

lemma cos_ge_1_sub:
  fixes u :: real
  assumes u: "0 \<le> u"
  shows "1 - u^2/2 \<le> cos u"
proof -
  let ?f = "\<lambda>x. cos x - 1 + x^2/2"
  have "?f 0 \<le> ?f u"
  proof (rule DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing[OF u])
    show "\<forall>x. 0 \<le> x \<and> x \<le> u \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>y. (?f has_real_derivative y) (at x) \<and> 0 \<le> y)"
    proof (intro allI impI)
      fix x :: real assume "0 \<le> x \<and> x \<le> u"
      then have "0 \<le> x" and "x - sin x \<ge> 0" using sin_x_le_x[of x] by auto
      moreover have "(?f has_real_derivative (- sin x + x)) (at x)"
        by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros simp: field_simps)
      ultimately show "\<exists>y. (?f has_real_derivative y) (at x) \<and> 0 \<le> y"
        by (intro exI[where x="- sin x + x"]) auto
    qed
  qed
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma sin_ge_cubic:
  fixes s :: real
  assumes s: "0 \<le> s"
  shows "s - s^3/6 \<le> sin s"
proof -
  let ?g = "\<lambda>x. sin x - x + x^3/6"
  have "?g 0 \<le> ?g s"
  proof (rule DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing[OF s])
    show "\<forall>x. 0 \<le> x \<and> x \<le> s \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>y. (?g has_real_derivative y) (at x) \<and> 0 \<le> y)"
    proof (intro allI impI)
      fix x :: real assume "0 \<le> x \<and> x \<le> s"
      then have "0 \<le> x" and "cos x - 1 + x^2/2 \<ge> 0" using cos_ge_1_sub[of x] by auto
      moreover have "(?g has_real_derivative (cos x - 1 + x^2/2)) (at x)"
        by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros simp: field_simps)
      ultimately show "\<exists>y. (?g has_real_derivative y) (at x) \<and> 0 \<le> y"
        by (intro exI[where x="cos x - 1 + x^2/2"]) auto
    qed
  qed
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma pi_ge_three: "3 \<le> pi"
proof -
  have "sin (pi/6) = 1/2" by (rule sin_30)
  moreover have "sin (pi/6) \<le> pi/6"
    using sin_x_le_x[of "pi/6"] pi_gt_zero by simp
  ultimately show ?thesis by linarith
qed

lemma jordan_sin:
  fixes t :: real
  assumes t0: "0 \<le> t" and t1: "t \<le> pi/2"
  shows "2 * t / pi \<le> sin t"
proof (cases "t \<le> 7/5")
  case True
  have "sin t \<ge> t - t^3/6" using sin_ge_cubic[OF t0] by simp
  moreover have "2 * t / pi \<le> 2/3 * t"
  proof -
    have "2 / pi \<le> 2/3" using pi_ge_three by (auto simp: field_simps)
    then show ?thesis using t0 by (simp add: field_simps) (smt (verit) mult_mono)
  qed
  moreover have "2/3 * t \<le> t - t^3/6"
  proof -
    have "t^2 \<le> 2" using True t0 by (nlinarith)
    then have "t^3 \<le> 2 * t" using t0 by (nlinarith)
    then show ?thesis by linarith
  qed
  ultimately show ?thesis by linarith
next
  case False
  define u where "u = pi/2 - t"
  have u0: "0 \<le> u" using t1 unfolding u_def by simp
  have pi4: "pi < 4" by (rule pi_less_4)
  have u06: "u \<le> 3/5" using False pi4 unfolding u_def by linarith
  have tu: "t = pi/2 - u" unfolding u_def by simp
  have sin_eq: "sin t = cos u" unfolding tu by (simp add: sin_diff)
  have c: "1 - u^2/2 \<le> cos u" using cos_ge_1_sub[OF u0] .
  have key: "2 * t / pi = 1 - 2 * u / pi" unfolding tu using pi_gt_zero by (simp add: field_simps)
  have "u^2/2 \<le> 2 * u / pi"
  proof -
    have "u * pi \<le> 4" using u06 pi4 u0 by (nlinarith)
    then have "u * u \<le> 2 * u / pi * 2" using u0 pi_gt_zero
      by (simp add: field_simps) (nlinarith)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: power2_eq_square) linarith
  qed
  with c sin_eq key show ?thesis by linarith
qed

lemma jordan_sin_min:
  fixes t :: real
  assumes t0: "0 \<le> t" and t1: "t \<le> pi"
  shows "2 * min t (pi - t) / pi \<le> sin t"
proof (cases "t \<le> pi/2")
  case True
  then have "min t (pi - t) = t" by linarith
  then show ?thesis using jordan_sin[OF t0 True] by simp
next
  case False
  then have "min t (pi - t) = pi - t" by linarith
  moreover have "sin t = sin (pi - t)" by simp
  moreover have "2 * (pi - t) / pi \<le> sin (pi - t)"
    using jordan_sin[of "pi - t"] t1 False by linarith
  ultimately show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma sine_key:
  fixes mu e t :: real
  assumes e0: "0 < e" and e1: "e < 1" and mu1: "1 - e \<le> mu" and mu2: "mu < 1 + e"
    and t0: "0 \<le> t" and t1: "t \<le> pi * mu / 2"
  shows "4 / pi^2 * (1 - e)^3 * t^2 \<le> mu * (sin t)^2"
proof -
  have pos: "0 < pi" by (rule pi_gt_zero)
  have mu0: "0 < mu" using mu1 e1 by linarith
  have cube: "(1 - e)^3 \<le> mu"
  proof -
    have "(1 - e)^3 \<le> (1 - e)^1"
      using e0 e1 by (intro power_decreasing) auto
    then show ?thesis using mu1 by simp
  qed
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "t \<le> pi/2")
    case True
    have "2 * t / pi \<le> sin t" using jordan_sin[OF t0 True] .
    then have "(2 * t / pi)^2 \<le> (sin t)^2"
      using t0 pos by (intro power_mono) auto
    moreover have "(2 * t / pi)^2 = 4 / pi^2 * t^2" by (simp add: power_divide field_simps)
    moreover have "0 \<le> 4 / pi^2 * t^2" by simp
    ultimately have "4 / pi^2 * t^2 \<le> (sin t)^2" by simp
    moreover have "0 \<le> (1 - e)^3" using e1 by simp
    ultimately have "(1 - e)^3 * (4 / pi^2 * t^2) \<le> mu * (sin t)^2"
      using cube by (intro mult_mono) (auto simp: mult_nonneg_nonneg)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  next
    case False
    define m where "m = pi - t"
    have m0: "0 \<le> m" using t1 mu2 mu0 unfolding m_def by (nlinarith)
    have sinm: "2 * m / pi \<le> sin t"
    proof -
      have "min t (pi - t) = m" unfolding m_def using False by linarith
      moreover have "t \<le> pi" using t1 mu2 mu0 by (nlinarith)
      ultimately show ?thesis using jordan_sin_min[OF t0] unfolding m_def by simp
    qed
    have sq: "4 / pi^2 * m^2 \<le> (sin t)^2"
    proof -
      have "(2 * m / pi)^2 \<le> (sin t)^2"
        using sinm m0 pos by (intro power_mono) (auto simp: divide_nonneg_nonneg)
      then show ?thesis by (simp add: power_divide field_simps)
    qed
    -- key inequality: mu * m^2 >= (1-e)^3 * t^2
    have pim: "2 * t \<le> pi * mu" using t1 by linarith
    have mm: "t * (2 - mu) \<le> mu * m"
    proof -
      have "mu * m = mu * pi - mu * t" unfolding m_def by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      moreover have "mu * pi \<ge> 2 * t" using pim by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      ultimately show ?thesis by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    qed
    have sq2: "(t * (2 - mu))^2 \<le> (mu * m)^2"
      using mm by (intro power_mono) (nlinarith, nlinarith)
      -- (t*(2-mu)) >= 0 needed for power_mono
    have bnd: "mu * (1 - e)^3 \<le> (2 - mu)^2"
    proof -
      have "1 - e < 2 - mu" using mu2 by linarith
      then have "(1 - e)^2 \<le> (2 - mu)^2" using e1 by (intro power_mono) auto
      moreover have "mu * (1 - e)^3 \<le> (1 - e)^2"
      proof -
        have "mu * (1 - e) \<le> 1" using mu2 e0 e1 by (nlinarith)
        then have "mu * (1 - e) * (1 - e)^2 \<le> 1 * (1 - e)^2"
          by (intro mult_right_mono) (auto)
        then show ?thesis by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      qed
      ultimately show ?thesis by linarith
    qed
    have main: "(1 - e)^3 * t^2 \<le> mu * m^2"
    proof -
      have "mu * ((1 - e)^3 * t^2) \<le> mu * (2 - mu)^2 * t^2"
        using bnd t0 by (intro mult_right_mono) (auto simp: algebra_simps intro: mult_nonneg_nonneg)
      also have "\<dots> = (t * (2 - mu))^2 * mu" by (simp add: algebra_simps power2_eq_square)
      also have "\<dots> \<le> (mu * m)^2 * mu / mu" sorry
      finally show ?thesis sorry
    qed
    have "mu * (4 / pi^2 * m^2) \<le> mu * (sin t)^2"
      using sq mu0 by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    then have "4 / pi^2 * (mu * m^2) \<le> mu * (sin t)^2"
      by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    moreover have "4 / pi^2 * ((1 - e)^3 * t^2) \<le> 4 / pi^2 * (mu * m^2)"
      using main by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    ultimately show ?thesis by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  qed
qed
